scenes.title: Data flow of the list API
scenes.narration: This list API demo is entirely fictional. Request out, reply in, then the list updates. The arrows only show the flow of data.

scenes.title: Four steps
scenes.narration: Enter a name and quantity, then send it. When the reply arrives, check status and ID. If both check out, add the item to the list.

scenes.title: Request and reply
scenes.narration: The sample request: paper lamp, quantity 2. The sample reply returns success and ID 7. The fields match up, and no network is used.
